IPT.evidence_source: [/page/20/Text/5] The Penn Optimism Program (POP) developed at the University of Pennsylvania was designed to prevent future depressive symptoms in children and young adolescents at risk. The intervention goals were to enhance participants' resilience in the face of negative life events by training them to challenge pessimistic causal explanations and teaching them other coping strategies
